text: Brent closed at 92.94 USD/bbl on 17 November, essentially flat on the previous close of 92.90 USD/bbl, and up 3.1% over the week. The 1-month change remains -22.1%, with prices between a low of 90.16 USD/bbl and a high of 128.30 USD/bbl. In Egypt, the bid deadline for the 14-block EGAS and EGPC rounds was extended to 14 December on 1 November.
